constraints: Never record verified status and never mutate committed canonical records
description: Promotion requires an approve review of the exact discovery content, a confirmed hash, and the ordinary intentctl workflow, and records verification as pending.
rationale: Retrospective claims are inferences; the canonical store keeps its trust model only if conversion needs a reviewer decision and can never fabricate verification or governing constraints implicitly.
requirements: Require a recorded approve review bound to the content hash plus --confirm
Default to historical bindings; active bindings need an applicability rationale
title: Only reviewed, explicit promotion turns a discovery into canonical intent
